hints.title: Sort Queries and Numbers
hints.text: Sort queries by limit m in ascending order and sort nums in ascending order to answer offline.

hints.title: Binary Bitwise Prefix Tree
hints.text: Incrementally insert numbers that are <= current query limit m into a binary bitwise prefix tree.

hints.title: Greedy Bit Traversal
hints.text: For query value x, walk down the tree choosing the opposing bit at each position from 30 down to 0 whenever available.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.time: O((n + q) * 31 + n log n + q log q)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every query against all elements takes O(n * q) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Offline query sorting with bitwise prefix tree evaluates maximum XOR in O(31) per query.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes offline processing pattern and builds 31-bit prefix tree.
